verdict.rationale: A hardware security-key vendor could plausibly ship developer SDKs, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows end-user management tools (SK Manager, OTP Tool, iePassManager) and standards compatibility (WebAuthn/FIDO2), plus the option to build Google's OpenSK firmware for Feitian hardware, which is a third-party project rather than an official Feitian SDK. No official SDK documentation is evidenced, and the API spec probe returned 404s on all paths.
